claims.claim: B rents a house with A
claims.mechanism: possessive 'our' in 'our rented house' includes B as co-tenant
claims.verifier_basis: The possessive 'our' linguistically entails that B is a co-renter of the house with A.

claims.claim: Ms. Connors is the landlord of B's rented house
claims.mechanism: appositive identifies the landlord of 'our rented house'

evidence.quote: Ms . Connors , the landlord of our rented house

claims.verifier_basis: A directly states Ms. Connors is the landlord of the house that B rents ('our').

claims.claim: B is a tenant/resident of the rented house
claims.mechanism: presupposition in 'us' referring to the household being threatened with eviction

evidence.quote: evict us for not paying the full rent

claims.verifier_basis: 'Evict us for not paying the full rent' entails that B is a tenant/resident subject to eviction for rent non-payment.

claims.claim: B is at the law school
claims.mechanism: direct assertion by A about B's whereabouts

evidence.quote: you are over at the law school

claims.verifier_basis: A directly asserts B's location at the law school.

claims.claim: B agreed to accompany A to meet Ms. Connors
claims.mechanism: A's gratitude in turn 11 presupposes B accepted the request made in turn 9

evidence.quote: Thanks a million , you are a lifesaver

claims.verifier_basis: A's effusive gratitude and 'you are a lifesaver' after requesting B's company linguistically entails B agreed to accompany A.

claims.claim: A's household did not pay the full rent to Ms. Connors after A deducted the dishwasher repair cost from the rent check

evidence.quote: deducted the cost from the rent check
evict us for not paying the full rent

claims.repair_of: B did not pay the full rent to Ms. Connors
claims.verifier_basis: A states 'us' in turn 7, which includes B as a member of the household. A explicitly states they deducted the cost from the rent check (turn 5) and that the landlord threatens eviction for not paying full rent (turn 7). The household's non-payment of full rent is directly asserted by A and entails B's membership in that household.

claims.claim: B agreed to come with A to meet Ms. Connors tomorrow night at eight
claims.mechanism: A asked B to come (turn 9) and thanked B as a lifesaver (turn 11), implying B agreed to the meeting

evidence.quote: So I wondered if you would mind coming with me when we talk to Ms . Connors . We ’ re supposed to meet with her tomorrow night at eight .
Thanks a million , you are a lifesaver .

claims.repair_of: B is supposed to meet with Ms. Connors tomorrow night at eight
claims.verifier_basis: A asks B to come with them to meet Ms. Connors tomorrow night at eight (turn 9). A's subsequent gratitude 'Thanks a million, you are a lifesaver' (turn 11) is a direct speech-act response that linguistically entails B accepted the request. The meeting time and participants are preserved.
